1.consolidated_definition: Expresión antigua, hoy desaparecida, que recoge Ledrú a fines del XVIII como “el insulto más grande que pudiera el orgullo dirigir a un criollo”, refiriéndose a la mayor concentración de la gente de color por las zonas costaneras del país.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Archaisms referring to the former concentration of people of color in coastal areas of the country, which Ledrú described at the end of the 18th century as "the greatest insult that pride could direct towards a Creole".
